name: Dispatch Order Divergence
essence: The earlier standard module finishes last and replaces the express shipping handler.

examples.summary: The earlier standard module finishes last and replaces the express shipping handler.
examples.mechanism: Asynchronous import-style initialization mixes methods into one shared table using Object.assign; completion order determines the winning handler.
examples.expected_behavior: shipping express when the later selected module should take precedence.

ingredients.suggests: Object.assign mixes overlapping handler names into the same route table.
Registration occurs after independently completed asynchronous initialization.

examples.expected_behavior: Select express by an explicit registration priority.

ingredients.suggests: Module initialization mixes overlapping handlers into one route table.

examples.summary: A later-finishing plugin installs its handler over the preferred shipping handler.
examples.mechanism: A plugin-style registration loader copies overlapping route maps after asynchronous initialization; Go package init ordering is not involved.

ingredients.suggests: Plugin route maps are mixed into one table with overlapping names.
Plugin installation writes after independently completed asynchronous initialization.
